intent: Implement Runtime 6.2.0 first run llm readiness with mandatory tenant/workspace profile binding, secure SecretRef-only setup, live provider preflight, fail-closed setup-only operation, explicit migration and headless bootstrap, and the README architecture diagram contract.
objective: Make EvoPilot operationally safe from the first process start: no LLM-dependent project or Harness-guided Goal Target Loop work may run until an explicit governed workspace LLM binding is live-preflight READY, while preserving provider neutrality, Host and Agent Runtime separation, external Harness authority, and all Runtime 6.1.0 guarantees.

evidence.authority: Roadmap mutation plus Runtime and Expert Target drafting authority only.
Current authoritative Roadmap after approved revision.
Immutable published Runtime 6.1.0 and Expert 2.1.0 completion baseline containing 305 criteria.

include: Add tenant/workspace RuntimeReadiness as a persisted, audited, concurrency-safe aggregate with SETUP_REQUIRED, PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED, READY, and LLM_BLOCKED transitions.
Add immutable explicit WorkspaceLlmDefaultBinding to exact profile identity and digest, provider, model, SecretRef, readiness evidence, actor, reason, and time.

Restrict a non-READY Runtime to the exact health, authentication, Expert MCP setup, provider discovery, secure SecretRef, profile CRUD and preflight, workspace binding and repair, diagnostics, and documentation allowlist.

Fail closed before READY for project activation, Harness matching or binding, Goal Target Loop and Lifecycle execution, Agent Runtime dispatch, Candidate, acceptance, release, publication, deployment, and production effects.

Resolve LLM use only by run override, project default, explicit workspace default, then LLM_PROFILE_REQUIRED; forbid all implicit environment, Host LLM, Agent Model, Agent configuration, MyGlm5, and hard-coded preset fallback.
Provide server-side live provider preflight, freshness, degradation to LLM_BLOCKED, explicit repair and rotation, safe in-flight boundaries, and restart persistence without silent profile switching.
Provide explicit headless bootstrap and one-time auditable 6.1 migration that materialize governed SecretRef, profile, preflight, binding, and audit resources and stop on ambiguity.
Protect raw secrets from every LLM context and durable output surface; accept only approved secure inputs and persist SecretRef only.
Add provider-neutral API, MCP, schema, CLI administrator and installer surfaces needed by Evolution Expert 2.2.0 without giving Expert durable truth or authority.

Add README Architecture prose plus authoritative editable SVG and PNG fallback showing exact Human, Host, Host LLM, Expert, MCP, Runtime, readiness, profile/provider, Agent Runtime/Model, Project Systems, and read-only Harness boundaries.
Add criterion-specific validators, all 15 declared E2E journeys, cross-product acceptance, impact closure, active soak, and full Runtime 6.1.0 plus Expert 2.1.0 no-regression evidence.
exclude: No bundled, default, privileged, or vendor-locked model provider and no import of the operator's current Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, shell, or MyGlm5 configuration.
No raw credential in conversation, prompt, Expert Core, generated Skill, MCP result, project or Lifecycle YAML, Harness binding, receipt, evidence, audit metadata, or logs.
No Harness authoring, reasoning, review, approval, Registry or Catalog mutation, publication, or evopilot-harness source change.
No embedded coding Agent, direct Runtime project-source modification, Host LLM reuse as Runtime LLM, or Agent Model reuse as Runtime control-plane LLM.
No Learning Interoperability implementation; its full scope remains deferred intact to Runtime 6.3.0.
No legacy Suite modification or Cutover, Host or Secret operation, Candidate, E2E execution, production or database access, publication, or Release under this draft.

acceptance.criterion: RuntimeReadiness persists exact tenant/workspace SETUP_REQUIRED, PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED, READY, and LLM_BLOCKED transitions with actor, reason, evidence, audit, idempotency, concurrency, and restart safety.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: State-machine, persistence, tenancy, concurrency, crash, idempotency, audit, and restart tests.

acceptance.criterion: WorkspaceLlmDefaultBinding pins exact profile identity and digest, provider, model, same-scope SecretRef, fresh readiness evidence, actor, reason, and time and rejects drift or cross-scope references.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schema, canonical digest, optimistic concurrency, tenancy, drift, replacement, repair, and audit tests.

acceptance.criterion: A non-READY Runtime exposes only the declared setup allowlist and returns deterministic repair-oriented errors for every blocked normal operation across HTTP, MCP, CLI administration, and internal orchestration.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Positive allowlist and exhaustive negative route, tool, command, orchestration, and privilege tests.

acceptance.criterion: LLM resolution uses run override, project default, explicit workspace default, then LLM_PROFILE_REQUIRED and records exact provider/model/profile attribution without any hidden fallback.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Precedence matrix, missing-binding, invalid override, attribution, and adversarial fallback tests.

acceptance.criterion: Server-side SecretRef resolution performs a minimum live provider preflight, records redacted freshness evidence, degrades to LLM_BLOCKED on invalid profile, revoked secret, stale readiness, or provider failure, and returns to READY only after explicit verified repair.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Provider contract fixtures, live isolated preflight, freshness clock, failure injection, rotation, repair, redaction, and no-silent-failover tests.

acceptance.criterion: Explicit headless bootstrap and one-time 6.1 migration create governed SecretRef, profile, preflight, binding, and audit resources; environment values never remain runtime truth and ambiguity stops without guessing.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh headless bootstrap, restart, cleanup, unambiguous migration, ambiguous migration, rollback, and zero-environment-fallback tests.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime 6.2 exposes one provider-neutral readiness and setup protocol used by Evolution Expert 2.2 across supported Hosts while retaining every fact, decision frame, secret reference, and durable transition in Runtime authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: MCP/API schemas, protocol negotiation, version skew, cross-Host semantic equality, idempotency, and authority tests.

acceptance.criterion: README contains an Architecture section linked to the authoritative editable SVG and PNG fallback with all required nodes, edges, boundaries, accessible alt text, local-link validity, and GitHub light/dark legibility.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Deterministic asset validation, structural SVG assertions, rendered README snapshots, accessibility inspection, terminology checks, and link tests.

acceptance.criterion: No model provider is bundled, preselected, privileged, or silently imported, including GLM, OpenAI, Kimi, Gemma, local, enterprise, MyGlm5, shell, Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, or CodeBuddy configuration.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh-install inventory, source/config scans, provider matrix, no-local-import E2E, and negative fallback corpus.

acceptance.criterion: No raw secret reaches an LLM context or any forbidden output surface; only SecretRef is persisted and cross-tenant or cross-workspace secret, profile, readiness, and binding access is rejected.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Taint/redaction tests, transcript and log scans, persistence inspection, tenancy attack corpus, and zero-leak evidence.

acceptance.criterion: A functioning Host LLM or Agent Model cannot satisfy Runtime readiness, and Runtime LLM, Host LLM, and Agent Model remain separately configured, attributed, authorized, and audited.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Host-only and Agent-only negative E2E, identity and usage attribution, protocol separation, and adversarial authority tests.

acceptance.criterion: READY is a hard prerequisite for every real published immutable HarnessBundle-guided Goal Target Loop, while Harness authority remains external and read-only and qualified external Agent Runtime execution remains separate.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Public HarnessBundle supply chain, pre-READY denial, READY success, pendingExecution, receipt, drift, monotonic composition, and no-Harness-mutation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Degradation and repair preserve safe in-flight boundaries, durable project and Loop state, explicit human authority, deterministic recovery, and no duplicate or uncertain external effect.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: In-flight failure matrix, restart/resume, receipt reconciliation, bounded recovery, and mutation suppression tests.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime, Expert, Agent Host, Host LLM, qualified Agent Runtime, Agent Model, user-selected provider, Project Systems, and evopilot-harness remain independent products or authorities exactly as represented by the architecture contract.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Architecture boundary tests, source dependency analysis, contract ownership checks, and forbidden-implication documentation assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Runtime 6.2.0 acceptance closes only when all current criteria and E2E, the immutable 305-item Runtime 6.1.0 and Expert 2.1.0 baseline, cross acceptance, 5400-second active soak, impact closure, zero leaks, zero hidden fallback, zero legacy Suite invocation, and NO_REGRESSION pass on one exact installed Candidate pair.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent criterion-level aggregation bound to Candidate bytes, Target digests, cross map, soak evidence, and zero failed, pending, stale, generic, unmapped, leaked-secret, hidden-fallback, or legacy-invocation items.

inheritedAcceptance.criterion: Every one of the immutable published Runtime 6.1.0 and Expert 2.1.0 completion contract's 305 criteria remains applicable, including earlier Runtime and Expert lineage, project-neutral Lifecycle evolution, real HarnessBundle behavior, external Agent Runtime conformance, cross-Host operation, security, impact closure, active soak, NO_REGRESSION, and zero legacy Suite invocation.
inheritedAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh successor validation of the complete v61 completion contract with item-level evidence and no exclusions.

regressionImpact.area: First-run readiness gates every Runtime and Expert path and can affect all published project, Lifecycle, Harness-guided Loop, Agent Runtime, provider, Host, persistence, security, evidence, acceptance, and release guarantees.
regressionImpact.reason: The immutable v61 completion-contract aggregate preserves exact item-level historical traceability while avoiding a second drifting copy of 305 criteria.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Install exact Candidates with no LLM profile or local Agent configuration, observe SETUP_REQUIRED, and prove every normal operation is blocked while setup-only surfaces remain usable.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Fresh-install inventory, readiness state, allowlist, exhaustive blocked-operation matrix, and zero imported configuration.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expose MyGlm5, CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and shell configuration to the isolated environment and prove none is silently imported or selected.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Controlled configuration fixtures, Runtime resource inventory, resolution trace, and hiddenFallbackCount=0.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Operate a functioning Agent Host and Agent Model while Runtime has no READY profile and prove Runtime remains SETUP_REQUIRED and all normal work is denied.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Host success, Runtime denial, separate identities and usage attribution, and no implicit credential reuse.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Evolution Expert guides provider choice, secure SecretRef creation, profile creation, live preflight, explicit workspace binding, and READY without raw credential exposure.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Cross-Host transcript semantics, no-echo input, Runtime resources, preflight evidence, explicit binding decision, and zero-leak scans.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A bad endpoint, model, or credential fails live preflight and leaves Runtime non-operational with exact redacted repair guidance and no fallback.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Provider failure matrix, readiness transitions, repair frame, redaction, and hiddenFallbackCount=0.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: After READY, consume a real public evopilot-harness Registry, Catalog, HarnessProfile, immutable HarnessBundle and components, then complete a Harness-guided Goal Target Loop through a qualified external Agent Runtime.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Asset chain and digests, combined plan, pendingExecution, receipt, trajectory, usage, artifacts, Loop state, and pre-READY negative control.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Restart Runtime after READY and prove the exact binding and redacted readiness evidence persist without reimport, drift, or secret exposure.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Before/after canonical digests, storage inspection, freshness policy, audit, and zero raw secret evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Revoke or invalidate the bound provider or SecretRef, observe LLM_BLOCKED, preserve safe in-flight state, and return to READY only after explicit verified repair.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Failure injection, state and receipt boundaries, repair and rotation audit, restart, and no duplicate effect evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Prove run override, project default, workspace default, then hard failure across distinct provider/model fixtures with exact usage attribution.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Complete precedence matrix, invalid and missing cases, canonical resolution traces, and provider/model usage records.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Attempt cross-tenant and cross-workspace profile, SecretRef, readiness, and default-binding access and prove fail-closed isolation.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Multi-tenant fixtures, authorization matrix, negative read/write/bind/preflight cases, and audit evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Convert one unambiguous explicit 6.1 global provider into governed resources and stop without guessing when the old configuration is ambiguous.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Successful and ambiguous migration fixtures, resource digests, audit, rollback, and zero environment fallback.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Explicit headless bootstrap creates governed SecretRef, profile, preflight and binding resources, removes transient input, and reaches READY without retaining environment fallback.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Opt-in command contract, no-echo source, resource and audit digests, process restart, and environment cleanup proof.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Begin setup in Codex, inspect in Claude Code, complete designated-human WorkBuddy scope, and resume from an independent Host and generic MCP using one Runtime truth and one Expert Core.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Exact Candidate/Core bindings, Runtime object equality, version negotiation, designated-human declaration, and cross-Host resume.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Render the public README architecture and independently verify every required node, edge, term, local asset, alt text, theme legibility, and forbidden implication.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: SVG structural assertions, PNG parity, README render snapshots, link and alt-text checks, and architecture terminology corpus.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Revalidate all current Runtime and Expert criteria plus the immutable v61 305-item baseline, cross acceptance, real HarnessBundle behavior, external Agent Runtime conformance, 5400-second active soak, impact closure, zero legacy Suite invocation, and NO_REGRESSION on exact Candidates.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Independent item-level recomputation with passed=total and every failure, pending, stale, generic, unmapped, leak, hidden fallback, silent exclusion, and legacy invocation count zero.

designDecisions.readinessTruth: Tenant/workspace RuntimeReadiness and explicit WorkspaceLlmDefaultBinding owned by Runtime
designDecisions.providerPolicy: User-selected provider-neutral profile with no bundled or hidden fallback
designDecisions.secretPolicy: Approved secure input to server-side SecretRef only; no raw secret in an LLM context
designDecisions.ordinaryHumanEntry: Evolution Expert 2.2.0 over canonical MCP inside a qualified Agent Host
designDecisions.hostBoundary: Host LLM and Agent Model cannot satisfy Runtime LLM readiness
designDecisions.executionPlane: Qualified external Agent Runtime receives exact pendingExecution
designDecisions.documentationContract: README Architecture section plus deterministic authoritative SVG and PNG fallback
designDecisions.deferredScope: Learning Interoperability is preserved intact for Runtime 6.3.0
